subject: Cooking
title: Bread Waste: The Hidden Crisis
description: A quick win: understand Bread Waste: The Hidden Crisis.

hook.text: One-third of all bread baked in the UK is thrown away. 900,000 tonnes per year — uneaten.

buildup.text: Supermarkets demand fresh bread daily. Unsold loaves from yesterday are discarded, not donated.

discovery.text: Bread is the most wasted food in developed nations — more than fruits, vegetables, or meat.

twist.text: In Brussels, a brewery turns unsold bread into beer — reviving an ancient Egyptian practice.

climax.text: Apps like Too Good To Go and bakeries like Bread Ahead now redistribute surplus bread at reduced prices.

punchline.text: We fought revolutions over bread scarcity. Now we throw it away.

quiz.question: What is the most wasted food in developed nations?

details.summary: Approximately 10 percent of all bread produced globally is wasted, making it one of the most discarded foods. British households throw away 900,000 tons of bread annually.
details.whyItMatters: Bread waste represents squandered water, energy, land, and labor along the entire supply chain. Reducing bread waste is one of the most impactful actions for food system sustainability.
takeaways: About 10 percent of all bread produced globally goes to waste
British households discard 900,000 tons of bread each year
Initiatives brew beer, make breadcrumbs, and redistribute surplus

faq.question: Why is so much bread wasted compared to other foods?
faq.answer: Bread stales quickly, making it unappealing within days. Retailers overstock to ensure full shelves and discard unsold loaves daily. Consumers buy more than they eat. Bread's low cost makes people less concerned about wasting it compared to expensive proteins.

faq.question: What creative uses exist for surplus and stale bread?
faq.answer: Toast Ale brews beer from surplus bread. Breadcrumbs, croutons, and bread pudding use stale loaves. Panzanella and ribollita are Italian dishes designed around stale bread. French toast was invented to use day-old bread. Apps connect bakeries with consumers for end-of-day surplus.
